# DingDone 1.0.16
## Improved
- Claude Code now alerts you when worker permissions, URL confirmation dialogs, or paused quota auto-resume flows need your attention. - Codex terminal sessions are now recognized as interactive, while nested MCP runs remain quiet.
## Fixed
- Claude Code completion notifications now stay accurate around cross-session activity, queued follow-up work, and long-lived artifact monitors. - Delayed announcements from an earlier DingDone launch no longer play after the app has been quit and reopened.

# DingDone 1.0.15
## Improved
- Claude Code waiting diagnostics now identify the delivery path using metadata only, making notification issues easier to investigate without recording message text, tool input, transcripts, or session IDs.
## Fixed
- Codex notifications now stay linked to the correct conversation after you edit an earlier message, so inbox navigation and reminders follow the latest active rollout.

# DingDone 1.0.14
## Fixed
- Codex thread links no longer stop unnecessarily after an extension update or because a different VS Code window encountered a connection problem. - When a Codex window does need recovery, DingDone now recommends reloading that window before restarting VS Code.

# DingDone 1.0.13
## Improved
- Clicking a Codex notification now opens its thread in the client where it is currently active, even when the thread was created in another client.
## Fixed
- Claude Code turns paused on a background build now announce progress instead of incorrectly reporting completion.

# DingDone 1.0.12
## Improved
- Audio notifications now wait for an output device to become available and retry transient playback failures, helping delivery recover after a sleeping monitor or audio-route change. - Claude Code now announces replies triggered by another agent session as progress instead of completion, reducing false “finished work” notifications during parallel work.
## Fixed
- Claude Code waiting notifications now react only to prompts that actually require your input, while completed or dismissed prompts clear stale reminders quietly. - The Settings window now restores at a usable minimum size and stays within the visible screen after display changes.

# DingDone 1.0.11
## Improved
- When updating across multiple versions, DingDone now shows the release notes for every release included in the update in a single window. - Release dates are now shown next to each version and follow the selected interface language.

# DingDone 1.0.10
## Fixed
- Background Codex runs launched through MCP, another coding agent, or a temporary workspace no longer trigger unwanted notifications or appear as sessions in DingDone.

# DingDone 1.0.9
## Fixed
- Clicking a DingDone notification from the native Codex app now opens the correct Codex conversation instead of routing to Visual Studio Code.

# DingDone 1.0.8
## What's new
- Quitting DingDone now immediately stops Claude Code and Codex speech, sounds, and notification history. Reopen the app to resume notifications without restarting agent sessions. - The existing “Waiting reminder” setting now also works with Claude Code, repeating an unanswered prompt once after your selected delay.
## Fixed
- Claude Code reminders now clear correctly when a prompt is answered or the session moves on, preventing stale “still waiting” announcements. - Cursor sessions are now recognized separately from VS Code, avoiding incorrect session-opening behavior from the inbox. - Claude Code sandbox, execution-environment, and policy failures now appear under the correct error category.

# DingDone 1.0.7
## Fixed
- Claude Code sessions with long-running background shell commands, such as development servers and file watchers, now announce completion instead of incorrectly reporting intermediate progress. - DingDone now recognizes background agents that finish through queued or attached task notifications, preventing stale intermediate-progress announcements.

# DingDone 1.0.6
## Improved
- Notifications now wait for audio to become ready after your Mac wakes, preventing missed voice announcements. - Event history now shows dates and keeps delayed playback results attached to the original notification. - Generated Codex workspace names are now spoken naturally in your selected language.
## Fixed
- DingDone no longer plays duplicate Codex notifications during ChatGPT Voice conversations.

# DingDone 1.0.5
## Fixed
- Codex sessions now open correctly from refreshed VS Code workspace windows after a Codex extension update. - False “waiting for input” notifications are now suppressed when a Codex Computer Use action has already completed or failed.

# DingDone 1.0.4
## Improved
- Premium voice notifications now wait a little longer for cloud speech before falling back to a system voice, improving reliability on slower connections.

# DingDone 1.0.3
## New
- DingDone now detects Codex hooks that still need approval and guides you to the correct settings.
## Improved
- Hosted voice previews are cached locally for faster repeat playback. - Per-project voice selection is available again. - The widget attention indicator now stays attached to the mascot.
## Fixed
- ElevenLabs connection status stays “Not checked” while a key is being entered and changes to “Connected” only after successful verification.

# DingDone 1.0.2
## Changed
- Restored the previous ElevenLabs connection-status behavior as part of a pre-launch recovery test.

# DingDone 1.0.1
## Fixed
- ElevenLabs connection status now stays “Not checked” while a key is being entered and changes to “Connected” only after successful verification.

# DingDone 1.0.0
The first public release of DingDone.
## What's new
- Voice notifications when Claude Code and Codex finish work, need an answer, or continue working. - Offline speech using macOS system voices, with language, voice, phrase, and per-project settings. - A menu-bar panel with recent events, quick sound controls, and navigation to the relevant project or session. - Agent Cockpit: a floating widget and a list of sessions that need attention. - A library of additional voices and secure DingDone Pro activation.
## Reliability and privacy
- Agent hooks call a separate CLI, so notifications continue to work when the DingDone window is closed. - Free mode with system voices works locally and does not require an account. - Full agent message contents are not written to the event log.
